title: Principles relating to processing of personal data
notes: Purpose limitation, minimisation, and storage limitation are design constraints; accountability under 5(2) is the duty to be able to show it.

title: Lawfulness of processing
notes: Lawful basis. A legal determination with no control counterpart.

Information to be provided where personal data have not been obtained from the data subject

notes: Subject access. The system must be able to produce everything held about one person, which nothing in the baseline requires.

title: Right to rectification
Right to erasure (‘right to be forgotten’)
notes: Erasure. The pipeline overlay finding on soft deletion lands here: a delete that leaves a retrievable copy does not satisfy this.

title: Right to restriction of processing
notes: Restriction of processing: a state the data model must be able to represent.

title: Notification obligation regarding rectification or erasure of personal data or restriction of processing
Right to data portability
notes: Portability. A structured, machine-readable export is an engineering obligation with no control counterpart.

title: Right to object

notes: Automated decision-making and profiling. No control in the catalogue addresses it.
